summary: Source-bound private Web list metadata and single-encoding canonical save; 50-message initial page.

components.owning_subsystem: Existing SessionStore and Web list/history adapters.
components.disposition: Optional private .display-meta <=8KiB, contains existing list fields including bounded 80-character preview, source identity and checksum for accidental corruption. Web display-only callers may use it; cache provenance prevents canonical parent_id_of, get_meta, default list/management/evidence paths trusting it. Missing/corrupt/changed view falls back to canonical read. Explicit bounded legacy backfill uses existing management/session locks and never rewrites canonical data. Physical delete cannot claim success while private sidecar remains. Single UTF-8 encoding reused by canonical write and existing position index; no new authority or service. Web history window reduced to 50 rows, API remains compatible.
evidence: Final 186 targeted Python tests passed; 67 WebUI files/668 tests passed, Ruff, Pyright, TypeScript passed.

Synthetic 100 sessions x1000 messages, 77,165,275 source bytes: process-cold canonical list median130.150ms vs display2.734ms, warm0.467ms, five samples/arm, OS cache not flushed, event log disabled; identical metadata.

Intermediate candidate with real run-owned lease, synthetic 10k messages and EventStore enabled: 10 saves, 100 concurrent reads, page P95 44.387ms, save median85.766ms/P95 97.568ms, 90 indexed/10 fallback, 1 revision changed, final 10010 rows, no exceptions. No real provider/HTTP.

Paired direct index publication 7 pairs: old list/join median8.327/81.183ms at 10k/100k vs pack_into8.510/82.300ms. Retained old implementation because no demonstrated latency benefit; single encoding retained. No claim write amplification solved.

Tests cover no full JSON parse on cold display, forged display metadata not becoming parent/ingress authority, corruption, external change, legacy rebuild, POSIX private permissions, failed sidecar write and failed physical deletion.
components.verification_level: Local targeted and WebUI tests passed. Independent final SHA review, original R9, remote CI, production acceptance and legacy maintenance backfill pending.
components.model_evidence_veto_recovery_exit: Veto if display metadata can authorize ingress/topology/management, if private metadata is not removed on successful physical deletion, if source changes silently serve stale metadata, or if real workload write cost/latency regresses. Exact oversized message expansion and response-byte budget, cold event read and mobile/desktop real acceptance remain open; no incremental persistence migration without real evidence.
components.rollback_route: Revert code; canonical JSON remains backward-compatible. Old readers ignore .display-meta and .history.idx; private display sidecars can be removed under existing maintenance ownership without changing source.
